discordPostHtml:
A Discord exclusive mod that retextures cargo into lobsters .

Changelog:
1.1.8b for 0.98a-RC8 

Updated the Plasma Dynamo
Added supplies_old variant 
Updated mod_info.json

Still no fancy preview BUT this time I will hide the quest & some unused items' lobster variants

All updates should be save game compatible.

PSA for people using this mod : you can remove any lobster , flag or sound you find undesirable as it only replaces vanilla files.
PSA for mod makers: you don't need to ask me directly for permision to use a sprite, just credit me somewhere, or don't.
